result.title: Flow cells with hydrogel coating (AU family)

limitations: L3: comprising: attaching a silane or a silane derivative to a surface of a patterned substrate including a flow channel having depressions defined therein
L4: wherein the depressions are separated by interstitial regions
L5: thereby forming silanized depressions and silanized interstitial regions
L6: applying a functionalized coating layer in the silanized depressions and on the silanized interstitial regions
L7: polishing the functionalized coating layer from the silanized interstitial regions
L8: grafting a primer to the functionalized coating layer in the silanized depressions to form a grafted functionalized coating layer in the depressions
L9: and applying a hydrogel on the grafted functionalized coating layer in the depressions
L11: The method as defined in claim 1 or 2

evidence_passages: The prior art (AU2021204165B2) discloses a method for forming a hydrogel coating on a flow cell surface.

The method involves attaching a silane or silane derivative to a surface of a patterned substrate, applying a functionalized coating layer, polishing the coating layer, grafting a primer, and applying a hydrogel.

motivation.motivation_passage: The prior art discloses a method for forming a hydrogel coating, but the process can be improved.
motivation.proposed_modification: Using a hydrogel coating on a flow cell with a hydrogel coating
motivation.why_this_specific_modification: To improve the hydrogel coating process and increase its effectiveness.
motivation.expected_benefit: Improved hydrogel coating process and increased effectiveness.
